name: Thunderlord

frame.name: Reign Havoc
frame.description: Final blows with this weapon generate stunning lighting strikes from above. Lightning strikes grant a stack of Bolt Charge. Strong against [Disruption] Overload Champions.

perks.name: Polygonal Rifling
perks.description:
Barrel optimized for recoil reduction.
  •  Increases stability

perks.name: Armor-Piercing Rounds
perks.description:
Rounds cause extra damage to combatants' shields and overpenetrate targets. 
  •  Slightly increases range

perks.name: Lightning Rounds
perks.description: This weapon fires faster and more accurately the longer the trigger is held. Continuous damage generates stunning lightning strikes.

perks.name: Feeding Frenzy
perks.description: Each rapid kill with this weapon progressively increases reload speed for a short time.

flavor: They return from fields afar. The eye has passed, the end nears. Do not fade quietly. Let thunder reign again.

catalyst.name: Thunderlord Catalyst
catalyst.description: Causing a lightning strike with this weapon partially reloads the magazine from reserves.
